svg.title: Keep the maintained source and applied settings in step
svg.desc: Two computers each contain a chezmoi source folder and an applied settings file. The example maps dot_zshrc in the default source directory to .zshrc in the home directory. Apply goes from source to installed settings; capture goes back after an applied-file edit. The shell reads the applied file. Git transfers source changes between computers; chezmoi then applies the source on the receiving computer.
svg.text: Maintain settings, then apply them on each computer
The agent transfers source changes, then applies them locally
Capture edits to applied files before applying the source again
